subject: CloudVertex marketplace inquiry — intro + demo / scheduling
messages:
From: Thomas Green <thomas.green@cloudvertex.io>
To: sales@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question about your marketplace listing / trial

Hi Redwood team,

We found your listing on the cloud marketplace and spun up a short trial to evaluate inference throughput for low-latency web features. A few quick questions: how does Redwood handle bursty traffic for chat-style sessions, and could we get a short intro/demo to see the console and routing policies?

We are a small infra team at CloudVertex evaluating options — I can include our PM (Asha) if useful.

Thanks,
Thomas
Thomas Green
Senior Platform Engineer, CloudVertex
thomas.green@cloudvertex.io

[Note: trial account id CV-TRIAL-993 attached]
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Thomas Green <thomas.green@cloudvertex.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question about your marketplace listing / trial

Hi Thomas — thanks for reaching out and welcome!

Happy to run a short 30-minute walkthrough focused on the areas you mentioned: burst handling, routing policies, and what you saw in the trial console. I’ve copied Neha (solutions engineer) and Rachel (AE) to join the call for capacity and pricing context.

Two quick options:
- Wed Mar 10, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Mar 11, 14:00–14:30 PT

If neither works, here’s my Calendly to pick a slot directly: https://calendly.com/monica-patel/30min

Also attaching a short demo deck that outlines our routing/fallback patterns and a tiny sample of the trial usage export you can share with your infra team.

Best,
Monica Patel
SDR, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
[attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf]
From: Thomas Green <thomas.green@cloudvertex.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@cloudvertex.io>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question about your marketplace listing / trial

Thanks Monica — Wed Mar 10 at 10:00 PT looks good for me, but Asha is on travel that day and asked if we could move to Thu Mar 11 at 14:00 PT so she can join. If you have a backup earlier that day we could also do 11:00 PT.

Asha — looped you in. Also, is there any chance you can share whether Redwood supports tenant-level caching (we're testing prefix reuse across sessions)? I attached a short CSV from the trial showing token distribution.

Regards,
Thomas
[attachment: trial_usage_report.csv]
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Thomas Green <thomas.green@cloudvertex.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question about your marketplace listing / trial

Perfect — thanks for the heads up. Rachel, Neha — could you join Thu Mar 11, 14:00 PT? If that ends up not working, we can also do Wed Mar 10 at 11:00 PT as the fallback.

Neha: quick note on caching — we do support per-customer prefix/KV caching and configurable TTLs. On the call we can go over best practices for multi-tenant isolation and token accounting.

I'll send a calendar invite for Thu Mar 11 at 14:00 PT and include a short agenda:
- 5m intros
- 10m trial findings + burst behavior summary (Neha)
- 10m routing/fallback & pricing overview (Rachel)
- 5m Q&A / next steps

Thanks — Monica
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Thomas Green <thomas.green@cloudvertex.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question about your marketplace listing / trial

Hi Thomas — I’ll be on the call Thu Mar 11 at 14:00 PT. A couple quick prep items so we make the most of 30 minutes:
- If you can share an approximate weekly token volume and % of spiky requests, that helps me pull up cost/comparison scenarios.
- If you want us to show a dedicated vs hosted routing demo, say so and we’ll prepare both.

I’ll also bring up the Reserved/Dedicated options and an example SLA for burst support. Looking forward to it.

— Rachel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thomas
